Good to know

Questions we hear most. Anything else, call (972) 730-6961.

Do you take reservations?

Yes. Book a table online any time. For large groups, call us at (972) 730-6961 so we can set up the right table.

Can I order takeout or delivery?

Yes. Order online through Chowbus for pickup or delivery, or call us to order by phone.

What should I order on my first visit?

Start with a few plates of skewers, like the Zesty Lamb, Angus Sliced Beef and Juicy Pork. Then share a Crispy Pork Crunch Rice Bowl and the Crispy Tofu Balls.

How spicy is the food?

Our skewers are seasoned with Grandma Yang's chili and spice blend. Dishes marked Spicy on the menu bring more heat. Ask your server about heat levels when you order.

Do you have vegetarian options?

Yes: the grilled vegetable skewers (chives, corn, zucchini, potato, cauliflower, green beans, mushrooms and cabbage), crispy tofu balls, smashed cucumber salad, potato pancakes and sweet potato fries. The King Roasted Eggplant is topped with minced pork. Please tell us about any dietary needs when you order.

Is there parking?

Yes, there is free parking in the shopping center lot right outside our door.

Do you cater or host parties?

Yes. We put together skewer platters for groups and cater birthdays, office lunches and family gatherings. See catering and parties.

Can I buy your chili powder?

Yes. Our Soul Chili Powder, the same blend we use on every skewer, comes in a take-home jar.

Guizhou-style skewers grilled over live charcoal, from Grandma Yang's family recipes since 1980.
